_meta.description: Primary category buckets for curated spots. Every spot in bali-spots.json has exactly one `category` drawn from this list.
_meta.note: Categories are the primary filter. Cross-cutting qualities (Memorable, Must Visit, Cultural, Outworldly) live in each spot's `tags` array instead.

categories.label: Beaches
categories.description: Sand, surf and swimming spots along Bali's coastline.

categories.label: Nature
categories.description: Rice terraces, ridges, cliffs and volcanic landscapes.

categories.label: Waterfalls
categories.description: Jungle cascades, canyon falls and swimming pools.

categories.label: Culture
categories.description: Royal water palaces, rock-cut shrines and living traditions.

categories.label: Temples
categories.description: Pura across the island, from sea temples to mountain sanctuaries.

categories.label: Cafés
categories.description: Specialty coffee, slow mornings and long laptop afternoons.

categories.label: Food
categories.description: Warungs, seafood grills and places worth planning a day around.

categories.label: Hidden Gems
categories.description: Quiet places that reward the extra effort to reach them.

categories.label: Photography
categories.description: Spots that exist in the itinerary because of the frame.

categories.label: Adventure
categories.description: Diving, trekking, snorkelling and early alarm clocks.

categories.label: Wellness
categories.description: Yoga, healing, spas and deliberate slowness.

onboardingInterests.label: All
onboardingInterests.note: Selecting All clears every other interest and disables filtering.

onboardingInterests.label: Sunset
onboardingInterests.note: No category of its own. Resolved by parsing each spot's `bestTime` for a late-afternoon window.

onboardingInterests.label: Shopping
onboardingInterests.note: Listed in the onboarding spec but has no curated spots yet. Hide this chip until the dataset supports it.
